chunks: I have come out of my city either as an oppressor or as the oppressed, either as a rebel or one against whom rebellion has been committed.

key_terms.مَبْغِيّاً عَلَيْهِ: one against whom aggression is directed

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's purpose when leaving Medina for Basra?
ai.summary: In this pivotal address from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) clarifies his political and military stance by categorizing his journey into four possible states: being the oppressor, the oppressed, the aggressor, or the one against whom aggression is directed. This rhetorical device underscores his humility and accountability to divine justice, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on his readiness to accept any outcome as long as truth prevails. The statement serves as a foundational text for understanding his governance model, balancing decisive action with spiritual detachment from worldly power.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I have come out of my city either as an oppressor or as the oppressed, either as a rebel or one against whom rebellion has been committed.
